description: This file is a Perl script named 'chainlint.pl' that implements a tool for scanning shell scripts for test definitions and checking those tests for issues such as broken && chains or unclosed heredocs. It includes classes for lexical analysis ('Lexer'), shell script parsing ('ShellParser'), test-specific parsing ('TestParser'), and script analysis ('ScriptParser'). The script also contains a 'main' package that handles command-line options, report generation, and concurrency. The primary purpose is to analyze shell scripts in a project for correctness and potential bugs related to test definitions.

classes.name: Lexer
classes.description: Lexical analyzer that tokenizes POSIX shell scripts, handling special shell syntax and here-documents.

classes.name: ShellParser
classes.description: Recursive descent parser for POSIX shell scripts, with methods for consuming tokens and parsing constructs like groups, subshells, case statements, loops, functions, and commands.

classes.name: TestParser
classes.description: Subclass of ShellParser that recognizes test definitions within scripts, extracting test bodies and analyzing them for common problems such as missing '&&' or '|| return'.

classes.name: ScriptParser
classes.description: Subclass of ShellParser that identifies individual test definitions and passes test bodies to TestParser for analysis.
